listing.name: GoldenEye 007 — Nintendo 64 (Project Midas)

Windows/Linux/Deck packages; preserve upstream limitations. Upstream platforms: Windows/Linux packages and Steam Deck archive. Exact CPU/OS minimums beyond package documentation Unknown.
